verdict.rationale: Nitrokey is a hardware security key and HSM product (FIDO2, OpenPGP, PIV, OTP, NetHSM). A built-in AI assistant that takes delegated tasks is outside this product category, and nothing in the evidence shows Nitrokey ships any assistant capability, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
